title: Simon Dixon: What It Would Take for Me to Sell My Bitcoin for Gold
summary: ▶ Bitcoin Magazine Simon Dixon: What It Would Take for Me to Sell My Bitcoin for Gold Simon Dixon, CEO and co-founder of BnkToTheFuture, tells BMTV there are only three things that would make him sell all of his Bitcoin and buy gold. This post Simon Dixon: What It Would Take for Me to Sell My Bitcoin for Gold first appeared on Bitcoin Magazine and is written by Patrick Green .
